repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When migrating system features, we copy settings from old indices into
the new indices we create before reindexing. However, if we happen to
copy a write block, this causes the reindexing to fail.

Here, we strip the index block settings before applying settings to new
indices.

Fixes #80654

issue.body:
As surfaced by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/80654#issuecomment-974894992 there might be a way to enhance the error messages presented to the user when system indices migration fails.

Few ideas could be:

* Enhance the callout by adding which index was that it failed for and show a little popover with the same information for the failed state in the flyout. 
* Add a show more details button in the error callout that opens a little modal that shows the stack trace that ES returns as an error, though I'm not sure this will be of much help to our users nor if its something we already do in Kibana.
